The remodel is in place. Refresh **http://maker:4001** and let's walk through it.

**Flow 5 (revised) — the reading list as a status.**
1. Notice new saves are ordinary by default; only flagged ones show a **To read** badge. On any bookmark, click **Mark to read** — a badge appears and it now shows up under the **To read** view.
2. In the **To read** view, click **Mark as read** on one — it leaves the reading list but is still there under **All**.
3. When **saving** a new link, the review panel has a **Mark to read** toggle (off by default) so you can add it straight to the reading list.

**Flow 6 — archive as a separate state.**
1. On a bookmark, click **Archive.** It disappears from **All** — and I verified it also drops out of **normal searches** (searching for a word only in an archived item returns nothing).
2. Click the **Archived** view — there it is, with a **Restore** action that brings it back to your normal collection.
3. Archiving is fully separate from deleting — nothing is destroyed.

Two things to confirm:
- **The Reference view** now simply means "everything not currently flagged to-read." Does that match what you pictured?
- **Deleting** — you mentioned archive should stay different from *permanently deleting*. I haven't added a delete action yet. Do you want an outright **Delete** (with a confirm) available too, or is Archive enough for now?
